title: RentGuard Renters Policy Midterm Change Figures — Training Note
content:
Three tier figures of the RentGuard Renters Policy come up whenever a policy changes during its term: the calendar days after moving within which a new rental address is to be reported, the calendar days Coverage C applies at both the old and the new residence while moving, and the amount below which a midterm prorated premium change is neither billed nor credited.

| Tier | New rental address reported within (calendar days after moving) | Coverage C at both residences while moving (calendar days) | Minimum midterm premium change billed or credited (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 30 | 30 | 2.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 30 | 30 | 2.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 30 | 30 | 2.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 30 | 30 | 2.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 30 | 60 | 1.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 30 | 60 | 0.00 |

## Questions answered

**What is the reporting period for a new address on each tier?** 30 calendar days after moving, on all six tiers.

**How long does Coverage C follow the insured's property at both residences?** 30 calendar days on HO-4 Starter through HO-4 Premier, and 60 calendar days on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.

**Which prorated amounts are too small to post?** Those below the tier's minimum midterm premium change: below 2.00 on the four lower tiers and below 1.00 on HO-4 Premier Plus. On HO-4 Signature the figure is 0.00, so no amount of 0.00 or more falls below it.
